glosses: stop, stopover, station (a place where one stops on the way; the act of stopping itself)
station (area equipped to serve as a regular stop; compare usage notes below)
station (place where workers are stationed, e.g. a weather station or space station)

examples.text: Die Station ist in der Nähe.
Die Station ist hinter dem Platz.
examples.en: The station is behind the square.
What's the name of that station?

examples.text: Steigen Sie an der nächsten Station um.
examples.en: Change trains at the next station.
